title: 夜市怎麼買最開心
question:
你帶了一些錢去夜市，有 3 樣想吃的東西，每樣最多買一份。每樣都有價格和「喜歡程度」。
請輸入帶了多少錢，再依序輸入 3 樣東西的價格和喜歡程度，輸出不超過預算時，喜歡程度加起來最多是多少。
想想看：「先買最喜歡的」一定最好嗎？看第二組測資。

test_case.note: 雞排 60 元喜歡 8；奶茶 45 元喜歡 6；臭豆腐 50 元喜歡 7。買奶茶加臭豆腐 95 元，喜歡 13
先買最喜歡的雞排（70 元）就只剩 30 元；其實買兩樣 50 元的，加起來 12 比較多

en.title: Best Night Market Plan
en.question:
You bring some money to the night market. There are 3 foods you want. You can buy at most one of each. Each food has a price and a "like" score.
Input your money. Then input the price and like score of each food. Output the biggest total like score you can get without going over your money.
Think: Is "buy your favorite first" always best? See test 2.

test_case.note: Food A 60 (like 8), B 45 (like 6), C 50 (like 7). B + C costs 95, like 13
The favorite (70) leaves only 30. Two 50s give 12, which is more
